# Thorium Dioxide
Monazite Dust cracked in 250 mB of Lye in the Chemical Reactor gives Thorium Dioxide, and usually Rare Earth Dust.
# Breeding
Thorium Blanket Rods (thorium pellets in a Zircaloy Tube) don't fission much themselves: in the core, thorium absorbs neutrons and breeds Uranium-233.

# THOREX
Switch the PUREX Plant to THOREX and spent blanket rods give Thorium Dioxide back and Uranium-233 Oxide.
# U-233 fuel
One Uranium-233 Oxide and three Thorium Dioxide make four U-233 Fuel Blend: pressed, sintered and rodded into U-233 Fuel Rods, which breed more U-233 as they burn.
